name: tukar
description: Confidential cross-border payment corridors on Stellar

scripts.video: python scripts/make-vo.py && node scripts/record-narrated.mjs https://tukar-six.vercel.app && python scripts/mux-video.py && python scripts/tight-cut.py
scripts.video:full: python scripts/deck-vo.py && node scripts/record-deck.mjs https://tukar-six.vercel.app && python scripts/build-final.py
scripts.video:demo-id: python scripts/make-vo-id.py && node scripts/record-narrated.mjs https://tukar-six.vercel.app && python scripts/mux-video.py && python scripts/tight-cut.py && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('build-video/tukar-tight.mp4','build-video/tukar-demo-id.mp4')"
scripts.circuit:threshold: ./tools/bin/circom.exe circuits/thresholdDisclosure.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -o circuits/build && npx --no-install snarkjs groth16 setup circuits/build/thresholdDisclosure.r1cs circuits/build/pot14_hez.ptau circuits/build/thresholdDisclosure_0.zkey && npx --no-install snarkjs zkey contribute circuits/build/thresholdDisclosure_0.zkey circuits/build/thresholdDisclosure_final.zkey --name=k1 -e="threshold key"
scripts.circuit:aggregate: ./tools/bin/circom.exe circuits/aggregateDisclosure.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -o circuits/build && npx --no-install snarkjs groth16 setup circuits/build/aggregateDisclosure.r1cs circuits/build/pot14_hez.ptau circuits/build/aggregateDisclosure_0.zkey && npx --no-install snarkjs zkey contribute circuits/build/aggregateDisclosure_0.zkey circuits/build/aggregateDisclosure_final.zkey --name=agg -e="aggregate key"
